- Decision factors you called out: accuracy on clinical Qs, PHI handling (KMS), latency under 500ms P95, and cost run-rate for pilot.
- Timeline: internal pilot decision targeted early April; procurement + security review expected in March.

Requests / next steps:

2) Please introduce the security contact (SOC 2 / infosec) and the procurement lead so we can align on evidence and SOW timing.
3) Any mandatory legal/contract terms we should surface early (data residency, IP, indemnity)?

If helpful, I can send a one-page checklist (security + procurement asks) to speed things up. Marissa — looping you in to own the economic-buyer mapping / proposal. Neha — could you prep a short list of the docs Orion will likely ask for (SOC 2, penetration test summary, data retention policy)?

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a 20-min call with Carlos or Anita next week.
